c.v: Watchdog timers have the following features:
Four stages, each with a programmable timeout value.
Each stage can be configured and enabled/disabled separately
Three timeout actions (interrupt, CPU reset, or core reset) for
and four timeout actions (interrupt, CPU reset, core reset, or system reset) for RWDT upon expiry of each stage
Write protection, to prevent RWDT and MWDT configuration from being altered inadvertently
If the boot process from an
flash does not complete within a predetermined period of time, the watchdog will reboot the entire main system.
